posts.title: Token Exchange (On-Behalf-Of): Swapping Tokens for Downstream APIs
posts.description: Why resource binding alone is not enough # v09 binds each access token to a named API at mint time. The client sends resource on authorize and token; the auth server sets JWT aud (or introspection aud ) to that URI. Gated routes on the resource server reject tokens bound to the wrong API.
